clue.text: Floats in the air after mistake made by propellers

definitions.note: the clue names what produces the air currents, standing for those currents themselves

indicators.note: after places the floating piece behind the mistake piece in the answer

parts.note: a slip is a small mistake or error
a banner streams when it floats out on the breeze

explanation.surface: Something drifting in the air follows a blunder caused by aircraft propellers.
explanation.definitionFit: Propellers drive a current of air backwards behind an aircraft, and that backward current is what the word names.

clue.text: Deposited dial face up

indicators.note: in a down clue, facing upwards means the word dial is read from the bottom, so backwards

explanation.surface: A clock dial was left lying with its face pointing upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Laid is a past tense of lay, meaning put down or deposited.

clue.text: To proceed father wears hollow shoes

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

indicators.note: a hollow word is emptied of its middle, leaving only the outside letters of shoes

explanation.surface: Dad sets off in worn-out shoes with holes in them.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass is to go forward or proceed, as in passing along a road.

clue.text: Robin's quiver might cause his enemies to do this

definitions.text: Robin's quiver might cause his enemies to do this

parts.words: Robin's quiver might cause his enemies to do this
parts.note: Robin Hood's quiver of arrows would make his foes shake with fear, punning on quiver as a shudder

explanation.surface: Robin Hood's quiver of arrows strikes fear into his enemies.
explanation.walkthrough: Quiver is both an arrow case and a shiver; Robin Hood's quiver makes his enemies quiver in the other sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to shake or shiver, as frightened enemies would.

clue.text: Upset a number of European birds

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word for a number reads backwards

parts.note: a sum is a number, the result of adding

explanation.surface: A count of European birds has been thrown into disarray.
explanation.definitionFit: Emus are large flightless Australian birds.

clue.text: Material comprising male lichen only

indicators.note: comprising here suggests the letters of lichen being made up into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fabric is said to be woven from male lichen and nothing else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comprising' is an unusual anagram signal, read as the letters making up the material; 'only' is filler for the surface. Mechlin is a Belgian lace.
explanation.definitionFit: Mechlin is a bobbin lace made at Mechelen in Belgium, a kind of fabric or material.

clue.text: Cap a pestle's vessel on the table

parts.note: a pestle is used for grinding in a mortar, its bowl
a board is a table, as in bed and board or a board laid for a meal

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a pestle and its bowl to be put on the dining table.
explanation.definitionFit: A mortarboard is the flat square academic cap worn at graduations.

clue.text: Infinitely — miles still to go by — why? we ask

indicators.note: the letters of miles still are made to go by in a different order, a rearrangement
a question we ask is spoken, so the word why is taken for its sound, the letter name

parts.note: the word why sounds the same as the letter Y

explanation.surface: Someone wonders why there are still so many miles left to travel, seemingly without end.
explanation.definitionFit: Limitlessly means without bounds, which is to say infinitely.

clue.text: Travel twice to the desert

parts.note: to go is to travel
bi is a prefix meaning two or twice

explanation.surface: Someone makes two journeys out to the desert.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is a great desert spanning Mongolia and northern China.

clue.text: Small bonnet made of wild-pansy

definitions.meaning: a small old-fashioned bonnet worn at the back of the head went by this name
a folk name for the heartsease, the wild pansy of the violet family

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase was both a name for a Victorian small bonnet and a country name for the heartsease flower.

clue.text: Small case for the regularly best pupil

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken, here the second, fourth and so on of best pupil

explanation.surface: A small case is awarded to the top pupil in the class.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for needles or cosmetics.

clue.text: Not a noisy, light carol

parts.note: not noisy means quiet or silent
the not carries over: something not light is dark, the night

explanation.surface: A quiet, cheerful carol is requested.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'Not' governs both words: not noisy is SILENT and not light is NIGHT; 'light' alone does not give the second piece.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the famous German Christmas carol Stille Nacht, sung in English.

clue.text: Paid sellers to distribute footwear

indicators.note: distribute means spread the letters of paid sellers about into a new order

explanation.surface: Merchants are paid to hand out shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Espadrilles are canvas shoes with rope soles, a kind of footwear.

clue.text: Drop in to teach

definitions.meaning: to put a liquid in drop by drop
to teach or impress something gradually on the mind

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to add liquid drop by drop and to impress ideas gradually on a learner.

clue.text: Gain computer access to register an old name

parts.note: to log is to record or register

explanation.surface: To enter a system one must record an outdated name.
explanation.definitionFit: To log on is to sign in and gain access to a computer system.

clue.text: Boy's brother associated with the Spanish tambourine

parts.note: Tim is a boy's name
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A lad's brother is linked with a Spanish percussion instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A timbrel is an old word for a tambourine or small hand drum.

clue.text: Topsy-turvy lad it seems gives a wave

definitions.note: the answer is an adjective, standing for the kind of wave it describes

indicators.note: in a down clue, upside down means the run lad it is read from the bottom up

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An upside-down boy waves at someone.
explanation.walkthrough: LADIT read backwards is exactly the answer, so 'Topsy-turvy' acts as a reversal in this down clue; 'it seems gives' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal wave is a huge sea wave, so the adjective names that type of wave.

clue.text: A German one accepts special order in return for dye

indicators.note: accepts means the German word takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: ein is German for a or one

indicators.note: in return means the letters for special order are read backwards

parts.note: S is short for special and O for order

explanation.surface: A German takes a custom request in exchange for some colouring.
explanation.definitionFit: Eosin is a red fluorescent dye used to stain biological samples.

clue.text: Test for the executive American

parts.note: EX is an abbreviation for executive

explanation.surface: A test is set for the US company boss.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam is an examination, a formal test of knowledge.

clue.text: Acts like some antelopes or deer, perhaps

definitions.meaning: female deer, antelopes, rabbits and hares are called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the verb form meaning performs and the plural of the name for female deer or antelopes.

clue.text: Righteous esprit de corps lacks point

indicators.note: lacks means the group-spirit word goes without the compass point

parts.note: esprit de corps is group spirit, morale
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A virtuous team spirit is missing its purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral as an adjective means righteous, behaving according to what is right.

clue.text: Fail to catch a particle on this specific flight

parts.note: to miss is to fail to catch
an ion is a charged particle

explanation.surface: Someone misses a tiny particle while on a particular flight.
explanation.definitionFit: A mission is a particular military or space flight sent out to perform a task.

clue.text: Sane gal produces food

indicators.note: produces suggests the letters of sane gal being worked into something new

explanation.surface: A sensible girl makes something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagne is an Italian baked pasta dish, a food.

clue.text: Trainer redirected to the ground

indicators.note: redirected means the letters of trainer are sent in a different order

explanation.surface: A coach is sent off to the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain is a stretch of land or ground and its physical features.

clue.text: Sideways pass, in due course, by man

parts.note: later means in due course, eventually
Al is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man will make a sideways pass eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: In American football a lateral is a pass thrown sideways or backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: In American football the noun names a sideways or backward pass of the ball.

clue.text: Lazy but I would still meet the French

parts.note: I'd is the shortened form of I would
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone is lazy but would still go and meet the French.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle means lazy, not inclined to work.

clue.text: Paid a soupcon to see the opera

indicators.note: a soupcon is a small part, so only a portion of the words paid a is taken

explanation.surface: Someone pays a little to see an opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Aida is Verdi's opera set in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Wait for a fish to be born first

indicators.note: first says the born piece comes ahead of the fish in the answer

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish, also called the orfe

explanation.surface: Someone waits for a fish to be hatched.
explanation.definitionFit: To bide is to wait, as in biding one's time.

clue.text: Rabbit on about the bird

definitions.meaning: to talk at length, idle talk
a small songbird of the thrush family, such as the stonechat

explanation.definitionFit: The word means talk informally, the slang sense of rabbit on, and is also the name of a small songbird.

clue.text: Mounted illumination on anchored vessel at night

definitions.note: the clue describes where and when the lamp is shown, standing for the lamp itself

parts.note: riding means mounted, as on horseback
light is illumination

explanation.surface: A lamp is fixed aboard a ship lying at anchor after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: A riding light is the lamp a ship shows while riding at anchor at night.

clue.text: Shortly, he will, we hear, become a horrible person

indicators.note: we hear means the contraction is taken for its sound when spoken

parts.note: shortly means contracted, so he will becomes he'll

explanation.surface: Before long, a man will turn into a nasty piece of work, we are told.
explanation.definitionFit: A heel is a contemptible, dishonourable person, a cad.

clue.text: Pledges to have dates

definitions.meaning: promises or commitments, especially to marry

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both promises, especially to marry, and booked appointments.
